itinerary.text: Departure from Marrakech in the morning, heading to the High Atlas via the Tichka pass located at an altitude of 2260m. Passing through Telouet and the Ounila Valley, we continue towards the Ait Benhaddou Kasbah, a fortified village and one of the most beautiful kasbahs in Southern Morocco. It has benefited financially from several major film shoots, including Lawrence of Arabia, Gladiator, and Jesus of Nazareth, and is now a UNESCO World Heritage site. Lunch at the Kasbah and head towards Ouarzazate for a photo stop at the film studios, before reaching El Kelaa M'Gouna, a large village at an altitude of 1450m, located almost at the junction of the M'Goun and Dades valleys. Off-road track through the Valley of Roses, passing through Ait Said, Tourbist, and Tamalout, which will lead us to Bou-Thrarar in the Valley of Roses. We continue on the track towards the Glaoui Ait-Youl Kasbah at the edge of the Valley of Figs. First night in a very friendly, clean, and comfortable family inn, ideal for an overnight stay.

After breakfast at the riad, we will set off for a two-hour walk in the heart of the Dades Gorges and canyons. We will cross the massif through the Dades Valley and M'semrir, exploring the rocky mountains that overlook the cliffs and the lush oasis. It is there that the ruins of ancient earth and straw fortresses mysteriously hide. Our journey will then continue towards the Todra Gorges, crossing a vast rocky plateau located at an altitude of more than 2,000 meters, where nomadic tribes live. After admiring these magnificent canyons, we will descend to the Todra Gorges for another walk, followed by a two-hour stroll in the palm grove. Dinner and overnight in a family guest house.

After breakfast, departure towards the Jebel Saghro mountain range to meet the nomads of the Ait Atta tribe. We will then descend towards the Draa Valley, where we will stop at noon for lunch in an inn in the heart of the palm grove. Our route will continue towards the Erg Chegaga desert, passing through Tamegroute, famous for its pottery village and its ancient Quranic library, and then through M'hamid. From there, we will take the track to reach the Chegaga dunes, while enjoying wonderful landscapes that alternate between ergs, regs, and hamadas. It will also be an opportunity to search for local fauna, including gazelles, antelopes, or ostriches that inhabit the region. After admiring the sunset over the dunes, the day will end with a night in a bivouac, under the stars.

A day of rest to make the most of your visit with the nomads, with lunch at their place and a visit to the oasis, or lunch at the camp in the shade of the tamarisk trees, as you wish. In the afternoon, a camel ride in the dunes to admire the sunset. Night at the camp with dinner and entertainment under the stars around the fire 🔥.

Early morning wake-up to watch the sunrise over the dunes, followed by breakfast. Departure for Foum Zguid, passing by Lake Iriqui and the desert plateau dotted with acacia trees, before reaching the paved road at Foum Zguid. Lunch on site, then continuation towards Taznakht, the village of Berber carpets, with a stop to visit a women's carpet association. We then transfer to Marrakech, passing through Imerzgane and the Tizi n'Tichka pass, arriving in Marrakech in the late afternoon. End of the circuit.

itinerary.text: After pickup from your hotel or Riad in Marrakech, we will head out early in the morning by 4x4 into the desert. We will cross the Tizi n'Tichka pass, then descend into the magnificent Ounila Valley where we will take a break to visit the Ait Benhaddou Kasbah. After the Tizi n'Tinifift pass, we will cross the Draa Valley, passing through magnificent oases, palm groves, and ksours. We will then continue towards the Erg Lihodi desert, passing through Zagora, Tamegroute, the village of pottery and the ancient Quranic library, before reaching the Mhamid desert at the Erg Lihodi bivouac for dinner and an overnight stay in tents with a campfire 🔥 and Berber songs under the stars.

First quiet wake-up in the heart of the desert and a delicious breakfast before heading to the great dunes of Erg Chegaga. Along the way, we will cross magnificent Saharan landscapes where ergs, regs, and hamadas alternate. This will also be the ideal opportunity to search for local fauna, including gazelles, antelopes, or ostriches that inhabit the region. We will stop for lunch in the shade of a tamarisk, the iconic tree of the Sahara. After continuing our journey through these wonderful landscapes, we will arrive at the camp. Our bivouac team will give you a warm welcome and invite you to settle in over a cup of fresh mint tea. In the afternoon, after a short walk in the dunes, you will set off for a superb camel ride to admire the splendid sunset over the sand ridges. The evening will begin with a tasty traditional dinner at the camp. After the meal, it's time for some conviviality around the campfire with musical entertainment accompanied by the Berber chants and drums of our team, before spending a magical night under the stars.

Early wake-up call to watch the sunrise over the dunes, followed by breakfast. Departure for Foum Zguid, passing by Lake Iriqui and the desert plateau dotted with acacia trees, then reaching the paved road at Foum Zguid. Continuation towards Taznakhte, the village of Berber carpets, with lunch on site, before heading to the foot of the High Atlas mountains to cross the Tizi n'Tichka pass once again to arrive in Marrakech in the late afternoon.

itinerary.text: Morning departure from Marrakech, heading to the High Atlas via the Tichka Pass at 2,260 meters altitude. The first stop will be the Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou, fortified villages... Lunch at the Kasbah and heading toward Ouarzazate with a photo stop at the cinema studios and the Kasbah of Taourirt, before continuing to El Kelâa des M'Gouna, a large village at 1,450 meters altitude, located almost at the junction of the M'Goun and Dadès valleys. We'll take the Valley of Roses route passing through Ait Saïd, Tourbist, Tamalout, which will bring us to Bou-Tgharar in the Valley of Roses. We continue on the track toward the Glaoui Kasbah of Ait-Youl at the edge of the Dadès Valley. First night at the Rihana guesthouse. Very clean and comfortable, ideal for a one-night stay.

After breakfast at the riad, walk through the Dades gorges and canyons. Cross the massif via the Dades Valley and Msamrir to reach the Tizi Nogdal Pass and its beautiful canyons. Picnic break in the mountains with a view of the Atlas, then descent to the Todra Gorges. Overnight stay and dinner at the hotel.

After breakfast, departure toward the Jebel Saghrou mountain massif, meeting the Nomads of Ait Ata. Descent to the Draa Valley, midday break for lunch in a guesthouse on the palm grove. We continue the road to the Erg Chegaga desert passing through Tamegroute, the pottery village and the ancient Koranic library, then on to the Mhamid desert. By track, access to the Chegaga dunes while enjoying wonderful landscapes: erg, reg, hamada, sunset over the dunes, night in a bivouac under the stars.

Day of relaxation to enjoy the maximum and the best visit to the Nomads with lunch at their place and visit to the oasis or lunch at the Camp, your choice. In the afternoon, a camel ride in the dunes to admire the sunset. Night at the camp with dinner and entertainment under the stars around a fire 🔥

Early wake up to watch the sunrise over the dunes, then breakfast. Departure for Foum Zguid passing by Lake Iriqui and the desert plateau dotted with acacia trees before reaching the paved road at Foum Zguid. Lunch on site, then continuation to Taznakhte, village of Berber carpets, visiting a women's weavers' association to discover their unique know-how. Finally, we continue our road to the famous Ksar of Ait Ben Haddou. A UNESCO World Heritage site, this architectural jewel is one of the most spectacular and best-preserved examples of earthen architecture in Southern Morocco, having served as a setting for many cult films. We will take a 1.5-hour walk to explore its fortified alleys, traditional houses, and climb to the collective granary which offers a panoramic view of the valley. Dinner and overnight in a clean and very quiet guesthouse.

For this last day, we will head back to Marrakech passing through the sumptuous Ounila Valley, famous for its earthen villages and wonderful contrasting landscapes, with a visit to the Kasbah of Telouet. We will then cross the Tizi N'Tichka pass (2,260m) in the High Atlas with a traditional lunch stop along the way. Arrival in Marrakech in the late afternoon. End of tour.

itinerary.text: Departure from Agadir at 8:30 AM in a 4x4 towards Taroudant, nicknamed 'the little Marrakech'. Carriage ride around the fortified city. Continue to Tilouine, saffron capital, visit to the fragrant museum. Crossing the Tizi-n-Tighatine and Tizi-n-Ikhsane passes towards Taznakhte (Berber carpet capital) with a visit to a women's association. Arrival in Foum Zguid, dinner and overnight in a traditional Riad.

After breakfast, departure to the great dunes of Chegaga. First stop at an oasis of 20 palm trees with water springs. Continue along the old Paris-Dakar rally track, crossing rocky desert (REG) and dunes (ERG), passing by the dried Iriki Lake to search for fossils. Lunch at Chegaga, camel ride to admire the sunset. Dinner and overnight in a bivouac under the stars.

After breakfast at the bivouac, 60 km of desert track to M'Hamid El Ghizlane. Explore the old adobe village. Drive up the Draa Valley (1200 km), crossing Zagora, the largest oasis of the valley. Lunch in a restaurant among palm trees. Departure to the Jebel Saghrou massif via the Tizi-n-Tazzazert pass (2,283m), meeting the Ait Ata Nomads. Descent to the Toudgha gorges, dinner and overnight in a guesthouse.

Breakfast with a view over the valley. Guided 1h walk through the valley, gardens and canyons up to the Toudgha gorges. Crossing the massif via Tamettoucht and Msamrir with its beautiful canyons. Descent to the Dadès gorges, walk through gorges and canyons. Lunch in a Riad overlooking the valley of figs. Dinner and overnight in a family guesthouse.

Departure from the valley of figs via Ait Youl, continue on track towards Bou-Tgharar leading to the Valley of Roses up to Kalaa M'Gouna (capital of roses). Continue to the Ait Ben Haddou Kasbah, a fortified village classified by UNESCO, film set for Lawrence of Arabia, Gladiator, and Jesus of Nazareth. Dinner and overnight in a guesthouse.

After breakfast, departure from Ait Ben Haddou, return via the national road passing by the film set 'The Hills Have Eyes' and the Tiouine dam (84m high). Passage through Taznakhte, crossing the two passes, lunch stop at Taliouine. Continue to Taroudant along the Souss River with argan trees on the hills. Arrival in Agadir around 6:00 PM. End of the circuit.

itinerary.text: Departure from Ouarzazate or Marrakech towards the desert, crossing the Little Atlas and the Draa Valley to reach our desert camp. Installation at the base camp and preparations for the start of the trekking adventure.

Elfaïja – Taska Oasis. Along a rugged path, we cross the fossilized Jbel Bani pass, panoramic view over the Elfaïja plateau. Descent into a ravine towards the Oumsafi riverbed, then across another stony plateau with acacia trees and solitary palms often visited by nomads. Continue along the river to Taska oasis, lunch on site. Afternoon climb and camp. Dinner and overnight in bivouac. 3.5 hours walking.

Taska Oasis – Amda Nomassafy. After sunrise and breakfast in the desert, our caravan continues along the Mhasser riverbed, lunar landscape with sparse vegetation, limestone and ironstone, passing nomadic sheepfolds. Lunch at Amda n'Oumsafy (small desert lake). Dinner and camp overnight. 4 hours walking.

Amda Noumasafy – Erg Elmassafy. After breakfast, we walk along the Lamhaser riverbed and the acacia plateau with other desert plants, rocky terrain passing near nomadic families, then descend to the first sand dunes of Erg Lmassafy. Lunch and evening camp at the foot of the dunes. 4 hours walking.

Erg Lmassafy – the Great Erg Chigaga. After sunrise and breakfast on the dunes, we cross small sand dunes along the river covered with endemic Calotropis plants and tamarisk trees. Arrival at the foot of the Chegaga dunes, tents set up, lunch and overnight on site. 3 hours walking.

Erg Chigaga – Kharte Lgarsime. Day of walking in the dunes of Chigaga, visit of a small fossil stone plateau in the middle of the dunes. Continue to the end of Chigaga dunes and arrive at Kharte Lgarsime tamarisks for lunch. Dinner and camp overnight. 5 hours walking.
Early morning wake-up, packing and breakfast. Transfer by 4x4 to Marrakech or Ouarzazate via M'hamid, Zagora, Agdz, Ouarzazate and the High Atlas. Arrival in the late afternoon. End of the tour.

itinerary.text: Departure from Marrakech in the morning, heading to the High Atlas via the Tichka pass at 2260m altitude. Passing through Telouet and the Ounila valley, we continue towards the Ait Benhaddou Kasbah, a fortified village and one of the most beautiful in Southern Morocco, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Lunch at the Kasbah and drive towards Ouarzazate for a photo stop at the film studios, before reaching El Kelaa M'Gouna, a large village at 1450m altitude. Off-road track through the Valley of Roses passing through Ait Said, Tourbist, and Tamalout to Bou-Thrarar. We continue on the track towards the Glaoui Ait-Youl Kasbah at the edge of the Valley of Figs. First night in a very friendly, clean, and comfortable family inn, ideal for an overnight stay.

After breakfast at the riad, we will set off for a two-hour walk in the heart of the Dades gorges and canyons. We will cross the massif through the Dades Valley and M'semrir, exploring the rocky mountains and the lush oasis where ruins of ancient earth fortresses hide. Our journey continues towards the Todra Gorges, crossing a vast rocky plateau at over 2,000m altitude, home to nomadic tribes. After admiring these magnificent canyons, we descend for another walk followed by a stroll in the palm grove. In the late afternoon, we drive towards the Jebel Saghro mountain range to meet the Ait Atta nomads, before descending to the village of N'kob. Dinner and overnight in an authentic traditional guesthouse.

After breakfast, we depart towards the magnificent Draa Valley, famous for its vast palm grove. Our route passes through the village of Tamegroute, known for its unique green pottery and ancient Quranic library. We continue towards M’Hamid for lunch. In the afternoon, we take the track through grandiose desert landscapes alternating between ergs, regs, and hamadas. This is also an opportunity to search for local fauna, including gazelles, antelopes, or ostriches, to reach the great dunes of Erg Chegaga. Admire a splendid sunset over the sand ridges before dinner and a night in a bivouac under the stars.

Wake up early to watch the sunrise over the dunes, followed by breakfast. Departure for Foum Zguid, passing by Lake Iriqui and the vast desert plateau dotted with acacia trees before reaching the paved road. Continuation towards Taznakht, famous for its Berber carpets, and visit a women's weaving association. Lunch on site, then drive to Marrakech via Imerzgan and the Tizi n'Tichka pass. Arrival in Marrakech in the late afternoon. End of circuit.

Cross the Dadès and Drâa valleys, explore kasbahs and oases, meet the nomads of Saghro, and reach the majestic dunes of Chegaga. Between camel rides, nights in bivouacs, and breathtaking landscapes, experience the very essence of the Moroccan Sahara.

itinerary.text: After pickup from your hotel or Riad in Marrakech, departure early in the morning by 4x4 towards the Great South. We cross the famous Tizi n'Tichka pass at 2,260m altitude, offering exceptional panoramas of the High Atlas. We descend to follow the ancient caravan route through the magnificent Ounila Valley: a spectacular canyon with striking contrasts. At the end of this valley, we stop to explore the famous Ksar of Ait Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site. We enjoy a one-hour walking tour. After the visit, we continue crossing the Tizi n'Tinifift pass to reach the mythical Draa Valley. Arrival in Zagora in the evening. Dinner and overnight in a warm, family-run guesthouse.

After breakfast, departure towards the Erg Lihoudi desert, passing through Tamegroute, famous for its green pottery and ancient Quranic library. After lunch in Erg Lihoudi, our journey continues towards the great dunes of Chegaga. We cross splendid Saharan landscapes where ergs, regs, and hamadas alternate. This is an opportunity to search for local fauna. Upon arrival at the camp, you receive a warm welcome with fresh mint tea. After settling in, a short walk in the dunes allows you to admire the sunset. The day ends with a friendly evening around the campfire punctuated by Berber songs, followed by dinner and a magical night in a bivouac.

A full day of relaxation to fully enjoy the magic of the desert. For lunch, several options are available: share an authentic moment with local nomads, eat comfortably at the camp, or opt for a traditional picnic in the shade of a tamarisk tree. You will have the opportunity to walk through the sand dunes. In the late afternoon, take a camel ride to admire the splendid sunset over the ridges. The day ends with a tasty dinner, Berber musical entertainment, and a magical night under the stars around the campfire 🔥.

Wake up early for the sunrise over the dunes, then breakfast. Departure for Foum Zguid, passing by Lake Iriqui and the desert plateau dotted with acacia trees, then reaching the paved road. Lunch on site, then continuation towards Taznakht, village of Berber carpets, with a stop to visit a women's carpet association. Transfer to Marrakech via Imerzgan and the Tizi n'Tichka pass. Arrival late afternoon in Marrakech. End of circuit.

itinerary.text: After pickup at your accommodation in Marrakech early in the morning, departure by 4x4 towards the High Atlas via the Tizi n'Tichka pass at 2,260m altitude. Our first stop is at Tizi n'Aït Barka for coffee with a panoramic view. We continue through the Atlas mountains with several photo stops before arriving in Ouarzazate for lunch. In the afternoon, a stop is planned to photograph the famous film studios and the Taourirt Kasbah. We then reach El Kelaa M'Gouna, a large village at 1,450m altitude. From there, we take the Valley of Roses track passing through the traditional villages of Ait Said, Tourbist, and Tamalout to reach Bou-Thrarar. Finally, we continue via the track leading to the Glaoui Kasbah in Ait Youl, on the edge of the Dades Valley. Dinner and overnight in a local, very clean, and comfortable inn, ideal for this first stage.

After breakfast at the inn, we start the day with a two-hour walk in the heart of the impressive Dades Gorges and canyons. We then cross the massif through the Dades Valley and M'semrir to explore spectacular rocky landscapes overlooking cliffs and the green oasis where ancient earth fortresses hide. After lunch on the way, our journey continues across a vast rocky plateau at over 2,000m altitude, where nomadic tribes live, before descending to the majestic Todra Gorges. We take another walk in the canyon, followed by a one-and-a-half-hour stroll in the beautiful Todra palm grove. Dinner and overnight at the hotel in the gorges.

After a hearty breakfast, head towards the majestic Jebel Saghro mountain massif, where you will have the chance to meet Ait Atta nomads. The journey continues with a descent towards the mythical Draa Valley, famous for its endless lush palm groves and traditional fortified villages. After a lunch break in an inn in the heart of the palm grove, you reach Zagora in the late afternoon. Once settled in your Riad, enjoy a moment of relaxation, wander the oasis gardens, or discover local crafts by visiting jewelry and tamarisk wood door-making cooperatives. Dinner and peaceful night in Zagora.

After breakfast, head towards the Erg Chegaga desert, with a cultural stop in Tamegroute to discover its pottery village and historical Quranic library. The journey continues via the track, offering total immersion in the heart of grandiose Saharan landscapes, between ergs, regs, and hamadas, where you might see ostriches, antelopes, or gazelles. After a memorable desert picnic, you arrive at the camp where the bivouac team welcomes you warmly with traditional mint tea. Enjoy a walk in the dunes to admire the splendid sunset, before concluding this magical day with a friendly evening by the fire, punctuated by Berber chants, followed by dinner and a night under the stars.

A full day of relaxation to fully enjoy the magic of the Sahara. For lunch, several options are available according to your desires: share an authentic moment with local nomadic families, eat comfortably at the camp, or opt for a traditional picnic in the shade of a tamarisk tree. You will also have the possibility to take a beautiful walk in the middle of fine sand dunes. In the late afternoon, take a camel ride on the ridges to admire the sunset. The evening ends with a tasty dinner, Berber musical entertainment around the campfire 🔥, and a magical night under the stars.

After admiring the sunrise over the dunes and enjoying your breakfast, take the track towards Foum Zguid. This timeless journey takes you across the vastness of the dry Lake Iriqui and a large desert plateau dotted with acacia trees, before reaching the paved road for lunch on site. The adventure continues towards Taznakht, a village famous for its Berber carpets, where you will visit a women's weaving association to discover their unique know-how. Finally, you reach the famous Ksar of Ait Benhaddou, a jewel of earthen architecture classified as a UNESCO World Heritage site. We take a one-and-a-half-hour walking tour to explore its fortified alleys, traditional houses, and climb to the collective granary. Dinner and overnight in a clean and very quiet guesthouse in Ait Benhaddou.

After breakfast at your hotel in Ait Benhaddou, we take the road back to Marrakech. Our route follows the sumptuous Ounila Valley, famous for its wonderful ocher canyon landscapes, terraced crops, and traditional mud-brick villages, with a visit to the Telouet Kasbah. We then cross the spectacular Tizi N’Tichka pass (2,260m) in the High Atlas with a traditional lunch stop on the way. Arrival in Marrakech in the late afternoon. End of circuit.

itinerary.text: Drive towards the Anti-Atlas mountains, rocky landscapes and Berber villages. Night in a traditional guesthouse.
Discovery of the magnificent Aït Mansour gorges, an oasis nestled between the cliffs. Continuation to Amtoudi. Night with locals, in an authentic setting.

Visit of the fortified granaries (Agadirs). Walk in the palm grove and the oasis. Easy walk in the gorges and surrounding villages. Meeting with the locals and discovery of local life. Free time to enjoy the peace and nature.
Drive towards the Atlantic coast and arrival in Sidi Ifni, an old Spanish town with Art Deco charm.
Visit of Legzira beach, famous for its cliffs and natural arches. Continuation to Mirleft. Night in Mirleft.
Passage through the Massa National Park, renowned for bird watching (bald ibises, flamingos, herons and other species). Nature walk in a preserved environment before returning to Agadir.

itinerary.text: Upon your arrival in Mhamid, the driver-guide will be waiting to welcome you and park your car. Then, departure towards the Chegaga dunes, enjoying the marvelous landscapes of Erg, Reg, and Hamada. Arrival at the camp... Our bivouac staff will welcome you to settle in with a fresh mint tea, followed by a camel ride in the dunes to admire the sunset. Evening with a campfire and Berber songs by our camp team, dinner, and overnight stay at the bivouac.
